claim: 在拥挤人群检测基准上，密度自适应 NMS 相对固定阈值 NMS 使 AP 增量大于 0，且 log-average miss rate（MR^-2）增量小于 0。

plan.data: CrowdHuman val 与 CityPersons val（拥挤人群基准，含遮挡标注）
plan.method: 同一检测器仅替换 NMS 模块：固定 IoU 阈值 NMS vs 密度自适应 NMS，各 3 个随机种子；报告 AP 与 MR^-2，并分遮挡程度子集报告

decision_criteria.supports: 密度自适应抑制在拥挤场景优于固定阈值抑制
decision_criteria.weakens: 自适应 NMS 无增益

decision_criteria.supports: 漏检率同步下降（不是靠多出框抬 AP）
decision_criteria.weakens: MR^-2 上升，说明增益以更多误检为代价

alternatives: 增益来自密度子网络引入的额外监督/正则效应，而非 NMS 阈值自适应本身（需把密度分支只训不用的对照组）
拥挤子集的增益被非拥挤图像上的退化抵消，整体 AP 不变

citations.quote: The contributions are threefold: (1) we propose adaptive-NMS, which applies a dynamic suppression threshold to an instance, according to the target density; (2) we design an efficient subnetwork to learn density scores, which can be conveniently embedded into both the single-stage and two-stage detectors; and (3) we achieve state of the art results on the CityPersons and CrowdHuman benchmarks.

Non-Maximum Suppression (NMS) is essential for object detection and affects the evaluation results by incorporating False Positives (FP) and False Negatives (FN), especially in crowd occlusion scenes.
